process.name: retrieve Odc request Data

TWComponent.script:
tw.local.sql = "SELECT ID, REQUESTNO, REQUESTNATURE, REQUESTTYPE, REQUESTDATE, REQUESTSTATE, REQUESTSTATUS, " +"PARENTREQUESTNO, FCCONTRACTNO, CONTRACTSTAGE, EXPORTPURPOSE, PAYMENTTERMS, PRODUCTCATEGORY, COMMODITYDESCRIPTION, " +" ODC_REQUESTINFO.CIF, CUSTOMERNAME, BASEDATE, ODC_REQUESTINFO.VALUEDATE, TENORDAYS, TRANSITDAYS, " +"CONTRACTMATURITYDATE, USERREF, PRODUCTCODE, PRODUCTDESC, STAGE, SOURCEREF, TRADEFOREFNO," +"DISCOUNT, EXTRACHARGES, OURCHARGES, AMOUNTSIGHT, AMOUNTDEFNOAVALIZATION, AMOUNTDEFAVALIZATION, COLLECTABLEAMOUNT, " +" OUTSTANDINGAMOUNT, MATURITYDATE, MATURITYDAYS, FINANCEAPPROVALNO, HUBCODE, HUBNAME, LIQAMOUNT," +" LIQCURRENCY, COLLECTIONCURRENCY, STANDARDEXRATE, NEGOTIATEDEXRATE, ALLOCATEDAMOUNT, TOTALALLOCATEDAMOUNT, TRANSACTIONREFNO," +" CBECLASSIFICATION, SHIPMENTMETHOD, SHIPMENTDATE, REVERSALREASON, CLOSUREREASON, IMPORTERNAME, IMPORTERCOUNTRY, " +" IMPORTERADDRESS, IMPORTERPHONENO, IMPORTERBANK, BICCODE, IBANACCOUNT, BANKCOUNTRY, BANKADDRESS, " +" BANKPHONENO, COLLECTINGBANKREF , "//64 +"ODC_FCTRANSACTION.ACCOUNTNO, ODC_FCTRANSACTION.POSTINGDATE, ODC_FCTRANSACTION.VALUEDATE, ODC_FCTRANSACTION.TRANSACTIONAMOUNT, ODC_FCTRANSACTION.AMOUNTINBPM, " +" ODC_PARTIESINFO.PARTYID, ODC_PARTIESINFO.PARTYTYPE, ODC_PARTIESINFO.CIF" +" FROM "+tw.env.LKP_DB_Schema+".ODC_REQUESTINFO" +" Inner join "+tw.env.LKP_DB_Schema+".ODC_FCTRANSACTION on ODC_REQUESTINFO.ID = ODC_FCTRANSACTION.REQUESRID " +" Inner join "+tw.env.LKP_DB_Schema+".ODC_PARTIESINFO on ODC_REQUESTINFO.ID = ODC_PARTIESINFO.REQUESRID "
+" where ODC_REQUESTINFO.REQUESTNO like '"+tw.local.requestNumber+"' ; "

tw.local.sql SELECT REQUESTNO, REQUESTNATURE, REQUESTTYPE, REQUESTDATE, REQUESTSTATE, REQUESTSTATUS, PARENTREQUESTNO, FCCONTRACTNO, CONTRACTSTAGE, EXPORTPURPOSE, PAYMENTTERMS, PRODUCTCATEGORY, COMMODITYDESCRIPTION, --RI.ISLIQUIDATED, RI.CIF, RI.CUSTOMERNAME, RI.BASEDATE, RI.VALUEDATE, RI.TENORDAYS, RI.TRANSITDAYS, RI.CONTRACTMATURITYDATE, RI.USERREF, RI.PRODUCTCODE, PRODUCTDESC, STAGE, SOURCEREF, TRADEFOREFNO, DISCOUNT, EXTRACHARGES, OURCHARGES, AMOUNTSIGHT, AMOUNTDEFNOAVALIZATION, AMOUNTDEFAVALIZATION, COLLECTABLEAMOUNT, OUTSTANDINGAMOUNT, MATURITYDATE, MATURITYDAYS, FINANCEAPPROVALNO, HUBCODE, HUBNAME, LIQAMOUNT, LIQCURRENCY, COLLECTIONCURRENCY, RI.STANDARDEXRATE, RI.NEGOTIATEDEXRATE, ALLOCATEDAMOUNT, TOTALALLOCATEDAMOUNT, TRANSACTIONREFNO, CBECLASSIFICATION, SHIPMENTMETHOD, SHIPMENTDATE, REVERSALREASON, CLOSUREREASON, IMPORTERNAME, IMPORTERCOUNTRY, IMPORTERADDRESS, IMPORTERPHONENO, IMPORTERBANK, BICCODE, IBANACCOUNT, BANKCOUNTRY, BANKADDRESS, BANKPHONENO, COLLECTINGBANKREF, CURRENTSTEPNAME, RI.BPMINSTANCENUMBER,
INV.INVOICENO, INV.INVOICEDATE,
B.BILLOFLADINGREF , B.BILLOFLADINGDATE,
FCT.ACCOUNTNO,FCT.POSTINGDATE, FCT.VALUEDATE, FCT.TRANSACTIONAMOUNT, FCT.TRANSACTIONAMOUNT, FCT.AMOUNTINBPM,
PI.PARTYID,PI.PARTYTYPE,PI.CIF,
CC.COMPONENT, CC.DEFAULTCURRENCY, CC.DEFAULTAMOUNT, CC.CHARGEAMOUNT, --CC.WAIVER , CC.ACCOUNTCLASS, CC.ACCOUNTNO, CC.BRANCHCODE, CC.CURRENCY, CC.BALANCE, CC.BALANCESIGN, CC.STANDARDEXRATE, CC.NEGOTIATEDEXRATE, CC.DEBITEDAMOUNT,
MTD.INSTALLMENTDATE, MTD.INSTALLMENTAMOUNT
FROM ODC_REQUESTINFO RI INNER JOIN ODC_INVOICE INV ON RI.ID = INV.REQUESRID INNER JOIN ODC_BILLS B ON RI.ID = B.REQUESRID INNER JOIN ODC_FCTRANSACTION FCT ON RI.ID = FCT.REQUESRID INNER JOIN ODC_PARTIESINFO PI ON RI.ID = PI.REQUESRID INNER JOIN ODC_CHARGESCOMMISSIONS CC ON RI.ID = CC.REQUESRID INNER JOIN ODC_MULTITENORDATES MTD ON RI.ID = MTD.REQUESRID
WHERE RI.REQUESTNO = '<#= tw.local.requestNumber #>'
